title: stored visualization configurations CFG0-CFG3: icons of the icon bar, config.json, GUI functions and store buttons
author: Claude-JG
description: A user request: four stored configurations CFG0 to CFG3 of the visualizationSettings, in ~/.exudyn/config.json as a list 'storedSettings' of four dictionaries with the difference to the defaults (created as four empty dictionaries, which equal a reset); an icon per configuration switches the whole settings to it (defaults plus the stored difference), CTRL+icon stores the current settings into it; the store settings window of the dialog gets buttons '-> CFG0' to '-> CFG3' with hints; exudyn.misc.GUI.StoreVisualizationSettings(SC, CFG=None|0..3) stores from a script, None being the regular visualizationSettings section.
releaseNotes: Four stored configurations CFG0 to CFG3 of the visualizationSettings in ~/.exudyn/config.json (storedSettings): the icons CFG0 to CFG3 of the icon bar switch to one (defaults plus what it stores), CTRL and the icon store the current settings in it; buttons -> CFG0 to -> CFG3 in the store settings window; exudyn.misc.GUI.StoreVisualizationSettings(SC, CFG=None|0..3) and ApplyStoredVisualizationSettings(CFG, SC) (revision2026c step RG6.19.7)
